notes.title: Cashier Employee, Custom Walls, and More
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

In this devlog, we’re sharing a round of [b]Quality of Life improvements[/b] that aim to make your experience in [b]Mini Racer Car Shop Simulator[/b] smoother, more enjoyable, and easier to manage — especially as your store grows.

These updates focus on helping you spend less time on repetitive tasks and more time doing what matters: building powerful cars and winning events.

[h2]🧾 Cashier Employee[/h2]

Once you reach a certain chapter in your progression, you’ll unlock the [b]Cashier Employee[/b]. This feature lets an NPC handle all transactions at the cashier desk for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/4aa0bc5fe1f732034ae1a23082d7cf0d5f49d913.png[/img]
Now, instead of running back and forth between stocking and handling customers, you can focus fully on managing your car builds, upgrading parts, or preparing for upcoming events while your cashier keeps the store running.

Want to take over the cashier role yourself? No problem. You can easily [b]switch roles by interacting with the employee[/b] at the counter:
- Interact with an active cashier to set them to [b]Idle[/b]
- Interact again while idle to assign them back to the cashier role

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/d96d6bf712cfa0fb369ebb2e03bdccb6364f66aa.png[/img]
This way, you can decide when you want to jump back in or let your employee handle it.

[h2]🎨 Wallpaper Decoration[/h2]

Not satisfied with the default store walls? You can now personalize your shop by purchasing and applying [b]custom wallpapers[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/24aa40b55b3cf512af6fb2f685a784ca1b5e9771.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/9b2cfdd2aaacd49f50cfcbc17077d46c3b8d7c75.png[/img]
There various design that you can buy to change the look of your store walls and helps reflect your personality so make your shop feel more like yours.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/87cd81950fc7a1068f64dbd85b87431fe5cfce99.png[/img]
[h2]🏷️ Rename Your Store[/h2]

You now have the option to [b]change your store’s name[/b] at any time. Just walk outside and interact with the nameplate above your store entrance to edit it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/dc43da12c2a8ac26070d0a50651abfc9c6fbdcae.png[/img]
Whether you want something funny, serious, or themed, your shop name is now yours to define.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/725c450725fab1361631fa5d3813bac0617ba252.png[/img]
[h2]🗑️ Indoor Trash Bin[/h2]

Tired of running outside just to throw away empty boxes? We’ve added a [b]Trash Bin inside the store[/b], located near the spare parts inventory area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/ed5dd351b480f38a04980926069fe0f584d26b44.png[/img]
Now it’s faster and more efficient to keep your workspace clean and organized.

[h2]🪧 Floating Info for New Items[/h2]

To help with orientation, we’ve added [b]floating labels above new equipment or racks[/b] when you purchase them. This makes it much easier to spot where new furniture or displays have appeared and prevents confusion about where to look or what to move.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/dbbbf68dd7b659521e9edc287773f2b30ec159c4.png[/img]
---

These are just some of the highlights in our ongoing effort to polish and improve the game. We’re constantly working to make the experience more intuitive and player-friendly, especially as the store expands and new systems are introduced.

Thanks as always for the support and feedback!

notes.title: Controller Support and Keybinding Options
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

In this devlog, we want to highlight a feature many players have been asking for that is [b]game controller support[/b].

Based on feedback from our previous games and demo sessions, we’ve heard loud and clear that many of you prefer using a controller while playing. That’s why in [b]Mini Racer Car Shop Simulator[/b], we’ve made sure to include [b]controller support as a built in option from the start[/b].

[h2]🎮 Your Choice to Use Controller or Keyboard[/h2]

You can now play the game entirely with a [b]gamepad controller[/b], whether you're managing your shop, customizing your cars, or taking them out for a race. Movement, interaction, menus, and even other interaction are all supported.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/ded6468d1a6c067a4faf9579ce3e50c000d6ebfc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/8abd2f9690cf47ff41d650798bb96bb60a5bca4c.png[/img]
Of course, keyboard and mouse are still fully supported as well and for both input types, we’ve added a layer of flexibility through [b]custom keybinding[/b].

[h2]🛠️ Customizable Keybinding for Both Controller and Keyboard[/h2]

We understand that every player has their own comfort zone when it comes to controls. That’s why you can now [b]remap buttons and keys[/b] to match your preferences. Whether you're using a controller or a keyboard, the input layout is fully configurable through the settings menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/a5163be1fc7e1b751a25e71e0c31b5b8232cf7e0.png[/img]
This means:
- Adjust button layout for your gamepad to feel just right  
- Set keyboard key that suit your playstyle  
- Mix and match as needed to fit your setup

Our goal is simple, we want you to enjoy the game in the way that feels most comfortable to you. Whether you’re playing on a controller, using keyboard and mouse, or switching between both we’ve made it possible.

That's all for now thank you!

notes.title: Special Offers from the Salesperson
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

In this devlog, we’re introducing characters that brings great value to your shop, but only if you catch them at the right time the [b]Salesperson[/b].

Unlike the usual systems where you manage stock through standard menus, the Salesperson is an [b]NPC who visits your shop from time to time[/b], offering special deals you won’t want to miss. If you're looking to boost your store’s inventory or upgrade your space on a budget, this is your chance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/094d6c5ea957ea714517d27282e2ae496011bfbc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/87691f69bafad58bad78aca473507fbc0037ce54.png[/img]
[h2]🧰 What Does the Salesperson Offer?[/h2]

The Salesperson doesn’t just bring one type of item and they can show up with different categories of goods, each offering strategic advantages:

[b]1. Discounted Box Bundles (Cars & Spare Parts)[/b]  
You might be offered [b]multi-item packs[/b] of car boxes or spare part boxes at a [b]reduced price[/b] compared to regular store listings. It’s a great way to restock quickly, especially when you're preparing for upcoming events or just starting to scale up your inventory.

[b]2. Discounted Sales Racks[/b]  
Occasionally, the Salesperson will offer [b]specific display racks[/b] at a lower cost. This is especially helpful if you're expanding your shop and need more shelf space without spending too much of your funds.

[b]3. Special Furniture Items[/b]  
Some of the rarest deals are [b]supportive furniture pieces[/b] that give passive bonuses to your shop. These items may help attract more visitors, improve your shop’s atmosphere, or even increase the [b]maximum selling price of your products[/b]. They're designed to help you optimize both aesthetics and store performance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/9ceba5855a5e647b5d922514888433cad654f7c0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/38b3ab51b5681fc0db3bab84b6c64e41a64e5f81.png[/img]

The Salesperson doesn’t stay long. They’ll appear [b]randomly on certain days[/b] and leave at the [b]end of the day[/b], so if you see them, make sure to take a moment and interact. Once they’re gone, you’ll need to wait for their next visit to get another shot at those limited-time deals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/02d07ccf7167d114df01b3a7096f89ca486f5432.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/79c8dbe1a07776110de76bfe0bf38852d96155c3.png[/img]

[b]Tip:[/b] If you’re saving up for something or managing your stock carefully, it’s worth checking in whenever the Salesperson shows up. You never know what kind of deal you’ll get.

We added the Salesperson to bring more variety and unpredictability into the shop loop. Not every deal will be essential but some might be just what you need at the right moment. It also gives you another reason to keep checking in on your store’s routine and creates opportunities to get ahead through smart timing and good resource management.

That's all for now thank you!

notes.title: Get Ready to Race: Event System Overview
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

In this devlog, we’re excited to introduce a key part of the Mini Racer Car Shop Simulator experience that is [b]racing events[/b]. These events are where your customized cars go head-to-head for rewards, bragging rights, and even prizes.

Whether you're tuning cars for speed, control, or smarter AI behavior, this is where all of it comes together.

[h2]🏁 Types of Events[/h2]

There are [b]three main types of events[/b] in the game:

[b]Racing Event[/b]  
The classic race format. Finish first to earn [b]cash rewards[/b] and sometimes [b]bonus spare parts[/b]. It’s a great way to test the overall strength of your build.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/4ffdc0a8cd195f48662de0a565d4dbe75bd9e07f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/3fba22543b04c446db9c36ad752fffae2f1dd275.png[/img]
[b]Time Attack Event[/b]  
Here, you’re racing against the clock. The closer your time is to the target record, the more [b]cash rewards[/b] you’ll receive. This event favors fast, efficient builds with strong acceleration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/0d62986cc1d08287332aed79d81de4e072bead90.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/0f7f4a9d3f386bfc928b34c2a73c04cc2e4d8d39.png[/img]
[b]Rival Battle Event[/b]  
A head-to-head challenge against a [b]rival and their custom car[/b]. Win [b]three times[/b], and you’ll unlock their exclusive vehicle for yourself. It’s one of the most challenging but rewarding parts of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/33c07dfd19fc0afb476a846cfa9bdbcd63c3f185.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/d61f03b1cd00c2f317dc9804f6b8d153527c44d2.png[/img]
[h2]🏆 Event Tier System[/h2]

Each event has a [b]Tier Level[/b], which limits the [b]maximum car rarity[/b] that can participate. For example, in a Tier 3 event, only cars with Rarity 3 or below are allowed.

This system is designed to keep things balanced and encourages you to maintain multiple builds, not just rely on your highest rarity cars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/9ba678ed42180db81904d16b695e0cf013ebd6ea.png[/img]
[h2]🗓️ Planning Your Race Week[/h2]

Events are scheduled on specific in-game days. You can view these in the [b]Calendar menu[/b] on your tablet and plan ahead for which events you want to join.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/20bc104b328abc8d58cca33e9813b453da929945.png[/img]
To help with planning, there’s also a dedicated [b]Event menu[/b] that summarizes upcoming events and their requirements, so you can easily track your goals and prepare accordingly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/148e06bdb50394c222d36e63e6810e78a7ef551b.png[/img]
This event system has been refined based on feedback from players who tried the demo and prologue. We want races to feel meaningful, strategic, and worth preparing for—whether you're here for the thrill of competition or the rewards that come with it.

Thank you for all of you who already tried or play the game on Demo version or Prologue, we’ve got more devlogs lined up, focusing on other features and content you’ll see in the full game.

notes.title: Optimization Update for Better and Smoother Play
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
In this devlog, we’re stepping away for a moment from gameplay content to talk about something just as important: performance optimization.

Thanks to all the feedback we received from players who tried the demo and prologue, we’ve been working hard to make the game run smoother, load faster, and feel better overall. These changes may not always be visible, but they make a real difference in how stable and comfortable the game feels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/111a7f2bcbc952a9ab517ee0ff1ea293ec618f58.png[/img]
[h2]What’s Been Optimized?[/h2]
Here are some of the key areas we’ve focused on:
[list]
[*] [b]Improved data loading[/b] – Game data is now loaded more efficiently, helping reduce wait times and lower memory usage, especially when transitioning between scenes.
[*] [b]Better data handling[/b] – We’ve optimized how background systems process data, minimizing small stutters and improving flow during gameplay.
[*] [b]UI performance improvements[/b] – Complex UI elements have been optimized so they no longer interfere with core systems, even when multiple menus are active.
[*] [b]Algorithm refinements[/b] – Several internal processes have been reworked to use less processing power, making gameplay smoother and more responsive.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/994d541c6d770699e63ae19ba3d84ea612663ea2.png[/img]
The game also includes a Settings menu that lets players adjust the game’s performance based on their hardware. These options have been available since the beginning, and include:
[list]
[*] [b]Quality settings[/b] – Adjust overall visual quality
[*] [b]Max FPS[/b] – Set the frame rate cap to suit your device
[*] [b]Anti-aliasing[/b] – Toggle smoothing options for sharper visuals
[*] [b]VSync[/b] – Sync frame rate with monitor refresh rate to reduce screen tearing
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/e3057cc817687286bc51adfb3d73a25cfce0e67a.png[/img]
These settings are useful whether you’re playing on a high-end setup or something more modest. Our goal is to make sure the game feels good to play across as many systems as possible.

All these improvements are designed to support a smoother and more reliable experience, from customizing your cars to managing your shop to racing on track. We want every part of the game to run efficiently so you can focus on playing, not waiting or tweaking constantly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/59e47462cf6b1c05ef96589d6cfa47564d82904d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/5d286c8b27e17a175cbc723c664cb543d238b907.png[/img]
You can already feel some of these improvements in the latest Prologue version, and we’ll continue optimizing other parts of the game ahead of the full release.

Thanks for reading. We’ve got more devlogs lined up, focusing on other features and content you’ll see in the full game.

notes.title: Balancing Spare Parts: A Better Way to Custom Your Cars
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
In today’s devlog, we want to give info that you will be encounter in the the full version of Mini Racer Car Shop Simulator regarding the spare part rebalancing.

Spare parts are central to how you improve your cars in the game. Whether you're aiming for better speed, sharper handling, or smarter AI performance, every upgrade counts. In the full release, we’ve made some key changes to how these parts work and how you unlock them and creating a more balanced and rewarding experience overall.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537470/6ea1a6ea64959b0be2560eeb3c369069b0929e15.png[/img]
[h2]Spare Parts & What They Do[/h2]
Before we talk about the balancing changes, here’s a quick breakdown of how spare parts and performance stats work together:
[h3]Performance Stats:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Top Speed[/b] – maximum speed your car can reach
[*] [b]Acceleration[/b] – how fast your car gets to top speed
[*] [b]Handling[/b] – stability and control, to make better speed in turns
[*] [b]AI Level[/b] – how smart your car is at choosing lanes and paths during races
[/list]
[h3]Spare Part Categories:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Motor[/b] – increases Top Speed, perfect for long straights
[*] [b]AI Engine[/b] – improves AI Level, helps your car make smarter decisions
[*] [b]Suspension[/b] – boosts Handling, giving you better control in corners
[*] [b]Turbo[/b] – raises Acceleration and Top Speed, ideal for fast recovery
[*] [b]Rim & Tire[/b] – improves Handling, especially on technical tracks
[*] [b]Chassis[/b] – enhances Acceleration, Handling, and Top Speed, offering balanced performance
[/list]
Choosing the right combination of parts makes a huge difference, especially as races get more competitive later in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537470/6ee8a12397cbeecad5cf455d1f69e50bacc48761.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537470/0eff72465045a98ef2cf4d91ab3c82aab925546f.png[/img]
[h2]What’s Changing in the Full Version?[/h2]
We’ve rebalanced two major things:
[olist]
[*] The effects of each spare part, to make every upgrade more meaningful
[*] The unlock progression, so that parts become available gradually, encouraging better planning
[/olist]
Even with this structured progression, there are still chances to earn parts early. You might get a high quality part from a car box bonus, or win them by placing well in race events.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537470/942680dee762e37928e24a1035226bb14f7788af.png[/img]
[h2]Custom Value and Selling Extras[/h2]
There’s more good news, by adding spare parts to a car not only improves performance but it also increases the car’s selling price. If you enjoy customizing cars for resale, this is a great way to earn extra income. And if you ever find yourself with spare parts you don’t need? No worries, you can sell excess parts directly. It's a useful way to turn leftovers into cash and fund your next upgrade or restock.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537470/53b30c26cd250de847ace9aaa4116976c824b10b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537470/b9384bd5aec7cc1addabc3a1561a2c26a0c1632a.png[/img]
With these balancing changes, we’re aiming to make gameplay feel more strategic, where your choices in upgrading and selling really matter.

That’s it for now. We’ve got more devlogs on the way covering more contents and feature you will encounter in the full version of the game.
